| `exposure.yes_without_amount_as` | `non-walker` (choices: walker, non-walker, exclude) | As walking_validation exposure.yes_without_amount_as (reproduces Lo 2022's 887 walkers); question for the original authors in TODO.md |  |
| `outcomes.arthroplasty_scope` | `right` (choices: right) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. Lo 2018 Methods: 'Any participant with a knee arthroplasty was identified as having Sx, ROA, and SOA' | Fixed at right (the side knee_status is run for): the discordance per-knee replacement rules need each knee's own replacement; 'either' would censor or grade 4 the unreplaced knee too (long_table refuses it) |
| `outcomes.replacement_counts` | `adjudicated_or_self_report` (choices: adjudicated_or_self_report) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. oai.derive.knee.REPLACEMENT_STATUS_COUNTS (from Lo 2022 p.1661): V99E*RPCF of 1 (self-reported) or 3 (adjudicated, confirmed), or RPSN = 1 (seen on a follow-up X-ray). Lo 2018 says only 'any participant with a knee arthroplasty' | A counted replacement with no day count (V99E*DAYS blank) never becomes SOA at a follow-up visit |
| `outcomes.roa_definition` | `kl2` (choices: kl2, kl2_jsn) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. OUTCOMES99 offers incident KL >= 2 (V99E?XIOA) and incident KL >= 2 with JSN (V99E?XIOAN); Lo 2018 used KL >= 2 |  |
| `outcomes.roa_rule` | `same_visit` (choices: same_visit, ever) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. Lo 2018 Methods: ROA = tibiofemoral KL >= 2; whether ROA is carried forward once seen is not stated |  |
| `outcomes.soa_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, known_false) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. Lo 2018 does not say whether SOA is missing or known absent when one component (pain or KL) is missing | known_false: no frequent pain (or KL < 2) rules SOA out even if the other component is missing |
| `readings.followup_project` | `latest` (choices: latest, p37) | Copied from analyses/steps_oa/assumptions.toml. Projects 37 and 43 (READPRJ 42 recoded to 37): follow-up films (72 and 96 months) were read in Project 37 (some by Project 42); which project's grade counts is not fixed by the release | latest: Project 43 where it read the film, else Project 37 (the module's FOLLOWUP_PROJECTS); p37: Project 37 only |
| `walking.primary_cadence` | `40` (choices: 40, 60, 100) | No published threshold for a walking minute; 60 = the lowest NHANES walking band and 100 = moderate intensity (Tudor-Locke & Rowe 2012). 40 is this ledger's choice, to allow for minutes only partly spent walking | The threshold used for the headline sentence in WALKING_SHARE.md. A minute only partly spent walking shows a diluted cadence (30 s at 100 steps/min records 50 steps), so higher thresholds understate walking. |

|---|---|---|
